title: SCH-CNT-002 ordinary enemy definition
description: An ordinary enemy definition. The project-owned typed validator in src/MechaMiner.Content/Categories/ remains authoritative; this schema is the draft 2020-12 mirror kept for editor and tool interoperability, and a fixture corpus proves the two reach the same accept/reject verdict on every structural case. See content/schemas/README.md. There is no armor field: doc 40's enemy-and-boss field list omits Armor while the mech list includes it, so Armor is a mech statistic. There is no contact_cadence either - all three of its members were the player baseline's own constants copied into fourteen files.

maximum.derivation: the standard schedule is 35 contiguous minute rows numbered from zero, so the last minute it names is 35 minus 1; the ceiling follows from the row count and moves with it

presentation_id.title: Logical presentation entry, required absent
presentation_id.description: Required absent: a definition carrying this field is an error. No accepted document says what a presentation definition contains, so no ID grammar has been minted for one, and minting a shape for a category with zero members would be inventing structure ahead of need. The field was declared-optional with a non-empty-string constraint, which accepted any string an author invented and validated nothing about it; rejecting the field outright fails loudly the first time somebody adds one instead of accepting an unauthorized value. The subschema is 'not' over the empty schema, which rejects every instance, so the fault is the field's presence rather than its shape and an authored empty string is rejected by the same rule rather than as an empty declared-optional field. The typed validator reports MMC-2010 and names the field. When an accepted document mints a presentation ID grammar, this declaration becomes that grammar; until then it has no minLength, because a length bound on a value that can never be authored explains nothing.

projectile.title: A projectile
projectile.description: Shared by an enemy's specialist attack and a boss's radial burst, because doc 40 names projectile and boss-ability parameters as one field group. There is no lifetime_seconds: both projectiles state their lifetime only as prose, and authoring a number no document states would be inventing a balance value.
